## Skill name

Proposed folder name (kebab-case):

## Target directory

Where should this skill live? (e.g. `company-wide/`, `hr/`, `engineering/`, `design/`)

## Who uses it

Which teams or roles will invoke this skill?

## What problem does it solve

A short description of the task this skill automates or standardizes.

## Inputs

What context or arguments does the skill need?

## Outputs

What does the skill produce?

## Related resources

Links to existing docs, examples, or tickets.
